title: Request Infra → Terraform PR
description: Request cloud infrastructure in plain language and get a governed Terraform pull request. Use this when a developer asks for a database, bucket, cache, queue or other cloud resource for a service. Inputs: request_text (the user's own words), service (service entity), environment (staging/test/production entity), data_sensitivity (public/internal/confidential), optional module, notes and resubmit_of (a rejected request to prefill from). Also runs from a module row (module preselected) or a rejected request row (resubmit). The workflow logs an Infra Request, an AI planner picks a catalog Terraform module and drafts a tech plan (keeping the requested values), an independent AI checks guardrails. Guardrail failures go to Exception Approval (any Port user, reason required). Passing plans auto-approve or ask the module's owning team (production, confidential data, or modules that require approval). Finally a coding agent opens the PR (30-minute timer) and the PR link is saved on the request.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Optional extra context for the platform team (deadlines, constraints, links).

default.jqQuery: if (.form.resubmit_of|type) == "object" then "Resubmission of " + .form.resubmit_of.identifier + ". It was rejected because: " + (.form.resubmit_of.properties.decision_reason // "no reason given") + ". What I changed: " else null end

module.title: Module (optional)
module.description: Pick a Terraform module if you already know which one you want. Leave empty to let the planner choose.

service.title: Service
service.description: The service that will own and use the resource (identifier of a service entity in the catalog).

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Target environment entity: staging, test or production. Production and confidential data always need human approval.

resubmit_of.title: Resubmit of (optional)
resubmit_of.description: Pick one of your rejected requests to start from its answers (or run this from the request's ⚡ actions). Change what the rejection reason asks for, then submit.

request_text.title: What do you need?
request_text.description: Describe in plain language the infrastructure you need and what it is for, e.g. 'A small Postgres database for order history' or 'A queue for payment events'. Include any sizes, counts or names you already know. Port AI: pass the user's own words here.

data_sensitivity.title: Data sensitivity
data_sensitivity.description: Sensitivity of the data the resource will hold: public, internal or confidential. If unsure, use internal; customer or financial data is confidential.

nodes.title: Log Request
nodes.description: Stores the request as an infra_request entity (id ir-<run id>).

inputs.description: JSON object string: input name -> value

module.description: terraform_module identifier from the catalog, or none

details.description: Markdown list of each rule with ✅/❌ and a one-line reason

properties.approval_reason: {{ [ (if (.outputs.trigger.environment | if type == "object" then .identifier else . end) == "production" then "production" else empty end), (if .outputs.trigger.data_sensitivity == "confidential" then "confidential data" else empty end), (if .outputs.check_guardrails.result != "pass" then "guardrail exception" else empty end) ] }}

relations.terraform_module: {{ .outputs.draft_plan.module | if . == "none" or . == "" then null else . end }}

nodes.title: Guardrails OK?
nodes.description: Pass continues to approval routing; anything else (fail) goes to Module exists? (no module -> Platform Team Decision, otherwise Exception Approval).

nodes.title: Fetch Module
nodes.description: Helper: reads the chosen module's requires_approval flag and owning_team from the catalog (Port API, no auth needed).

nodes.title: Needs Approval?
nodes.description: Human approval if environment is production, data is confidential, or the module requires approval. Otherwise (fallback) auto-approve.

outlets.title: Yes
outlets.expression: (.outputs.trigger.environment | if type == "object" then .identifier else . end) == "production" or .outputs.trigger.data_sensitivity == "confidential" or ((.outputs.fetch_module.requires_approval | tostring) == "true")

properties.decision_reason: Auto-approved: passed guardrails, no approval rule matched

nodes.title: Save Approval Reason
nodes.description: Helper: records why a person must approve (production / confidential data / module requires approval) before Owner Approval waits.

properties.approval_reason: {{ [ (if (.outputs.trigger.environment | if type == "object" then .identifier else . end) == "production" then "production" else empty end), (if .outputs.trigger.data_sensitivity == "confidential" then "confidential data" else empty end), (if (.outputs.fetch_module.requires_approval | tostring) == "true" then "module requires approval" else empty end) ] }}

config.description: Approve or reject infra request ir-{{ .workflowRun.identifier | gsub("wfr_"; "") | ascii_downcase }} ({{ .outputs.draft_plan.module }} for {{ (.outputs.trigger.service | if type == "object" then .identifier else . end) }} in {{ (.outputs.trigger.environment | if type == "object" then .identifier else . end) }}, data: {{ .outputs.trigger.data_sensitivity }}). Guardrails: {{ .outputs.check_guardrails.result }}. Requested by {{ .workflowRun.trigger.by.email }}.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why you approve or reject this request.

nodes.title: Save Owner Approval
nodes.description: Helper: records the human approval (approver, reason) before opening the PR.

nodes.title: Module exists?
nodes.description: Guardrails failed. If the planner found no catalog module (module = none), the platform team decides; any other failure goes to Exception Approval unchanged.

nodes.title: Platform Team Decision
nodes.description: No catalog module fits this request. The platform team either builds it by hand or delegates a new reusable module + usage file to a coding agent.

config.description: NO MODULE FITS infra request ir-{{ .workflowRun.identifier | gsub("wfr_"; "") | ascii_downcase }} ({{ (.outputs.trigger.service | if type == "object" then .identifier else . end) }} in {{ (.outputs.trigger.environment | if type == "object" then .identifier else . end) }}, data: {{ .outputs.trigger.data_sensitivity }}). The planner found no Terraform module in the catalog for this request, so no governed PR can be built from an existing module. Requested by {{ .workflowRun.trigger.by.email }}. Request: {{ .outputs.trigger.request_text }}. Choose: 'Do it manually (platform team)' = the platform team owns it and builds it by hand (no PR from this run). 'Delegate to a coding agent' = a Cursor agent writes a NEW reusable module plus the usage file for this request and opens a PR marked for platform review.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why you chose this path (e.g. 'one-off, we will do it by hand' or 'reusable, let the agent draft a module'). Required.

failed_rules.title: Failed rules
failed_rules.default: {{ (.outputs.check_guardrails.details | split("\n") | map(select(test("❌|To fix"))) | join("\n")) as $f | if $f == "" then .outputs.check_guardrails.details else $f end }}

workflowStatusLabel.text: Platform team is building it manually (no module fits)

nodes.title: Hand to Platform Team
nodes.description: No module fits and the platform team chose to build it by hand: status manual_platform, approver and reason saved. The run ends here.

nodes.title: Start Module PR
nodes.description: Delegated to a coding agent: records approver and reason, marks the request pr_opening and starts the 30-minute PR timer, like Start PR.

nodes.title: Build New Module PR
nodes.description: Cursor agent writes a new reusable module plus the usage file for this request and opens a PR marked as needing platform review.

nodes.title: Save Module PR Link
nodes.description: Saves the new-module PR link and marks the request pr_opened, like Save PR Link.

nodes.title: Exception Approval
nodes.description: Guardrail violation: a manager (any Port user) may approve it as an exception, with a reason, or reject it.

config.description: Guardrail EXCEPTION for infra request ir-{{ .workflowRun.identifier | gsub("wfr_"; "") | ascii_downcase }} ({{ .outputs.draft_plan.module }} for {{ (.outputs.trigger.service | if type == "object" then .identifier else . end) }} in {{ (.outputs.trigger.environment | if type == "object" then .identifier else . end) }}, data: {{ .outputs.trigger.data_sensitivity }}). The plan FAILED guardrails. Approve only if you accept the risk; approving opens the PR as-is. Requested by {{ .workflowRun.trigger.by.email }}. If the module is none, reject: no PR can be built.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why you approve this exception (or why you reject it). Required.

failed_rules.title: Failed rules
failed_rules.default: {{ (.outputs.check_guardrails.details | split("\n") | map(select(test("❌|To fix"))) | join("\n")) as $f | if $f == "" then .outputs.check_guardrails.details else $f end }}

nodes.title: Save Exception
nodes.description: Records the guardrail exception (approver, reason) before opening the PR.

nodes.title: Start PR
nodes.description: Marks the request pr_opening just before the coding agent runs and starts a 30-minute PR timer (pr_deadline); if it expires while still pr_opening, the Mark stuck PR automation sets pr_failed.

nodes.title: Reject Request
nodes.description: Rejected at Exception Approval (guardrail violation not accepted). Saves approver and reason.
